name: Residual Boundary Algebra completion space — antichain-semiring refinement

newly_fixed_or_constrained.statement: Minimal q-boundaries of upward-closed regions form the support-local bounded distributive lattice / idempotent commutative antichain semiring under minimized union and minimized pairwise state-join product.
Tested deterministic fixed-path predicate preimages preserve both semiring operations.
The two-ply Bellman threshold transformer is a monotone lattice polynomial over that antichain semiring.
Mixed opponent-reply cover generation is the concrete expansion of semiring multiplication before antichain minimization, not an additional missing semantic operator.
Raw up/union-closed multirelation successor-set antichains are semantically appropriate but not compact; on complete 4x3 the empty-root four-ply family already has 1024 minimal outcome sets.
Reply dominance and independent mover/opponent rectangle factorization do not materially remove the mixed-cover operation on the tested pathologies.

refined_candidate_core.threshold_region_algebra: support-local antichain semiring / upward-set distributive lattice
refined_candidate_core.bellman_operator: alternating lattice polynomial over preimage homomorphisms, semiring plus/times, and terminal constants

refined_open_region.question: Is the current board-fiber/residuated/four-front/antichain-semiring basis minimal, or can semantic structure be removed without losing exact action/state value?
Can A times B = Min({a join b}) be computed at earlier ranks/root scale in time/memory close to the output size rather than the Cartesian product size?
What canonical sparse representation captures mixed reply covers while preserving mover/opponent coupling?
Can Bellman lattice-polynomial transformers be fused/factored across board fibers without materializing every intermediate frontier?
Do actual Connect4 frontier widths and semiring products remain tractable to the empty 7x6 root under the best output-sensitive representation?
How does the antichain-semiring mixed-cover operation relate exactly to the clause/proof controllable-predecessor seam?
